seed: At Next defaults, with no switch touched: a caption line on the Captions track answers a right click with its own short menu, laid out by the timeline's menu table (docs/design/timeline-right-click.md): Edit Words, Join with Next Line and Start Here, then Delete, then More holding what the Captions track does as a whole. A right click with no hover before it finds its line too: it used to raise no menu at all, and a second right click after the first picked its line came up blank.

steps.comment: THE FIRST TEST: the line at three seconds, right clicked straight away.
THE SECOND TEST: another line, after the first right click picked its own.

steps.note: Two caption lines right clicked one after the other, each with its own five-row menu; More > Timing > Later moved every line later
